name: Walton Advanced Engineering, Inc.
summary: Walton Advanced Engineering, Inc., founded in Kaohsiung, Taiwan, in 1995, specializes in providing memory assembly and testing solutions to both domestic and international clients. The company offers a comprehensive suite of turnkey services, including IC packaging, final product testing, burn-in procedures, and direct drop shipment to end customers. Furthermore, it delivers electrical testing and crucial back-end support. In addition to its service activities, the firm is actively engaged in the design, production, sale, and trade of integrated circuit equipment. Previously, the company operated under the name Walsin Advanced Engineering, Inc.
